_comment_1: Build-time pin for the bundled JRE + Minecraft + Fabric. The fetch_*.py
_comment_2: scripts read this file at build time and HARD-FAIL on SHA-256 mismatch.
_comment_3: Bumping anything means editing this JSON — never edit constants in code.
_comment_4: JRE pin lives at root level for backward compat with fetch_jre.py;
_comment_5: MC + Fabric pins live under mc_pin / fabric_pin namespaces.
_comment_mc_1: Vanilla Minecraft Java Edition pin. fetch_minecraft.py uses the
_comment_mc_2: version_manifest_url to discover 1.21.4's per-version manifest URL,
_comment_mc_3: then re-verifies SHA-1 of every artifact against Mojang's own pins.
_comment_mc_4: We do NOT pin client.jar's SHA here — Mojang's manifest IS the pin,
_comment_mc_5: and we hard-fail if Mojang changes 1.21.4 (immutable per Mojang policy).
_comment_fabric_1: Fabric loader pin for MC 1.21.4. fetch_fabric.py uses the profile_url
_comment_fabric_2: to fetch the launcher profile JSON, then downloads its 8 libraries from
_comment_fabric_3: Maven and re-verifies SHA-1 against Fabric's own pins in the profile.
